steps.instruction: Pay Dynamo Parts 11 units x 378.57 USD = 4164.27 USD to account ACCT-DPX-5613 with memo 'purchase order'. Dynamo Parts has the lowest unit price (378.57, below Helix Wholesale 437.97 and Cedar Industrial 532.62).
Set KV key order/vendor to 'Dynamo Parts'.
Set KV key order/total to '4164.27' (11 x 378.57, two decimals).
